verdict.rationale: Docs show clear provisioning paths via Console, Terraform, and API (create/list/update/delete clusters, node pools, spot on-demand capacity, Capacity Finder for availability) plus kubeconfig/API tokens to authenticate and run kubectl commands to get code executing (coreweave-docs-1,4,5,7,8,20,23). However the primary provisioning model is Kubernetes cluster/node-pool based rather than a simple single on-demand instance flow, and there is no first-party or independent evidence confirming actual 'minutes-to-running-code' turnaround time. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent timing verification of provisioning speed, and a simpler single-instance (non-cluster) on-demand GPU workflow example.
